opens_with: the posting page's 'Apply for This Job' reveals the form on the same address

fields.text: input type=text with <label for>; required marked by ' *' in the label text only (no required attribute)

choice.widget: button.fab-SelectToggle (aria-haspopup=true) named '<label> <current value>' ('State –Select–', 'Country United States'), with a hidden native <select required> (opacity 0, aria-hidden) that mirrors ONLY the current value -- it holds one option and cannot be filled directly
choice.open: a real click on the toggle button
choice.options: a portal div.fab-MenuList role=menu at the end of the page; each item is role=menuitem (not option); a 'Search...' input sits at the top of the menu
choice.pick: type into the menu's Search box, then click the menuitem whose text equals the answer exactly ('Virginia', never 'West Virginia')
choice.value_shown: the toggle button's name changes from '<label> –Select–' to '<label> <value>'

fields.state: fab-SelectToggle with 60 entries: US states plus territories (American Samoa, ...)
fields.country: fab-SelectToggle, clearable, preset to United States

file.widget:
input type=file required (labelled 'file-input') behind a 'Choose File*' button; the section's text is a

Resume*
file.fill: set_input_files on the required input[type=file]; no click on 'Choose File' needed

fields.date: text input 'Date Available' with a 'Pick a date.' button (popup=dialog); typing mm/dd/yyyy works
fields.bot_trap: a text input and a hidden textarea labelled 'Please leave this field blank'
fields.captcha: reCAPTCHA checkbox at the bottom (the owner's)
